title: Protocol to generate mouse oviduct epithelial organoids for viral transduction and whole-mount 3D imaging
protocol: Euthanize mice by CO2 administration and/or cervical dislocation.
Spray the ventral surface of the mouse with 70% ethanol.
Make an incision down and then across the midline to expose the peritoneal cavity.
Move the gastrointestinal tract cranially and the fat pads caudally to reveal the uteri.
Trace the uteri laterally to find the oviducts adjacent to the ovaries.
Isolate an oviduct attached to a portion of the uterus and ovary.
Remove the uterus from the isolated oviduct.
Dissect and elongate the oviduct after removal of ovary and connective tissue.
Move the gastrointestinal tract cranially to reveal the uteri.
Follow each uterus laterally to locate the ovary and oviduct.
Cut out the ovary and oviduct, keeping a portion of the uterus.
Place the cut-out tissue into an ice cold dissection solution.
Dissect the oviducts under a dissection microscope.
Remove the ovary, uterus, and connective tissue during dissection.
If segregating distal and proximal regions, separate infundibulum and ampulla from isthmus and uterotubal junction.
Discard the ampulla-isthmus junction if segregating regions.
In a 200 μL drop of collagenase solution, pull apart oviducts into 1 mm segments using forceps.
Transfer segments and solution into a sterile 1.5 mL tube with 200 μL collagenase solution (total solution = 400 μL).
Incubate in a 37°C water bath for 40 minutes, agitating every 5 minutes by flicking the tube.
Centrifuge oviducts/cell suspension at 240×g for 5 minutes on a tabletop microcentrifuge.
Resuspend in 500 μL of 37°C PBS to wash the tissue/cells and repeat centrifugation.
Resuspend in 500 μL Trypsin-EDTA (0.5%) and incubate in a 37°C water bath for 5 minutes.
Add 500 μL of 2D media and then pass the suspension 10 times through a 18G needle attached to a 1 mL syringe.
Using a 200 μL tip, pass the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer into a fresh sterile Eppendorf.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 240×g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend in 200 μL of 2D media and perform a cell count using a hemocytometer.
Count cells using a hemocytometer.
Seed cells at a density of 20,000 cells per well in a 96-well flat-bottomed tissue culture plate.
Fill wells with 200 μL of 2D media.
Culture until the cultures reach 75% confluence, typically taking 2–5 days.
Maintain cultures in a humidified incubator at 37°C and supply with 5% CO2.
Change the media every 2–3 days.
Ensure cells are transferred to 3D cultures before reaching confluency.
Place sterile 24-well tissue culture plates in a 37°C incubator.
Thaw Geltrex on ice.
Prewarm sterile PBS, trypsin-EDTA (0.25%), and organoid media in a 37°C water bath.
Remove media from 2D cultures.
Wash wells with 200 μL of PBS.
Add 50 μL of trypsin-EDTA (0.25%) to recover cells, incubate at 37°C for 10 min, breaking apart cells by pipetting halfway through.
Add 50 μL of prewarmed 2D media and break apart cells by pipetting before collecting into a sterile Eppendorf, combining cells of the same type.
Centrifuge the single cell suspension at 240×g for 5 min on a tabletop microcentrifuge.
Resuspend in 200 μL prewarmed sterile PBS.
Count cells using a hemocytometer or automated cell counter.
Add 200 μL of prewarmed sterile PBS to the cell suspension and centrifuge again to wash the cells.
Resuspend cells in ice-cold Geltrex at a cell density of 500 cells per μL.
Pipette up to 50 μL of the cell suspension into the center of pre-warmed 24-well tissue culture plates.
Place the plates upside down in a 37°C incubator for 30 minutes to allow the Geltrex to set.
Once the Geltrex has set, add 500 μL of organoid media containing 10 μM Y-27632 to each well.
Culture the plates in a humidified 37°C incubator supplied with 5% CO2.
Fill the remaining wells with 500 μL of sterile PBS to maintain humidity.
Replace organoid media every 2–3 days without adding 10 μM Y-27632.
Add 10 μM Y-27632 only at the time of seeding.
Passage organoids every 7–14 days.
Wash organoids with PBS.
Add 1 mL of ice-cold PBS to each well.
Incubate the plate on ice for 1 h, breaking apart the Geltrex dome halfway through by pipetting.
Repeat mixing by pipetting after 1 h.
Transfer the organoid suspension to a prechilled 15 mL sterile tube.
Fill up to 10 mL with ice-cold PBS and mix by inversion.
Centrifuge the organoids at 100×g for 3 min at 4°C.
Resuspend in 500 μL of prewarmed trypsin-EDTA (0.25%) and transfer to a sterile Eppendorf tube.
Incubate for 10 min at 37°C, breaking apart organoids by pipetting at 5 and 10 min.
Centrifuge singularized cells at 240×g for 5 min on a tabletop microcentrifuge.
Resuspend in 200 μL of prewarmed sterile PBS and count cells using a hemocytometer or automated cell counter.
Add 200 μL of prewarmed sterile PBS to the cell suspension and centrifuge again to wash the cells.
Resuspend cells in ice cold Geltrex at a density of 500 cells per μL.
Wash organoids with PBS.
Add 1 mL of ice-cold PBS to each well for isolating organoids.
Incubate the plate on ice for 1 hour, breaking apart the Geltrex dome halfway through by pipetting.
Repeat mixing by pipetting after 1 hour to dissolve the Geltrex completely.
Coat a pre-chilled 15 mL sterile tube with 1% (wt/vol) ice cold PBS-BSA.
Coat pipette tips with the same solution before handling organoids.
Transfer the organoid suspension to pre-chilled 15 mL sterile tubes on ice.
Combine any remaining organoids in the wells with 1 mL 1% (wt/vol) ice cold PBS-BSA.
Fill up to 10 mL with ice cold PBS and mix by inversion.
Centrifuge organoids at 100 g for 3 min at 4°C.
Resuspend organoids in 1 mL ice cold 4% (wt/vol) PBS-PFA and incubate on ice for 45 min, mixing halfway through by pipetting.
Fill up to 10 mL with 0.1% (vol/vol) PBS-Tween20 and mix by inversion.
Centrifuge organoids at 100 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend organoids in 4°C organoid wash buffer (OWB).
Segregate organoids into required wells of a 24-well plate, containing at least 200 μL OWB per well before addition.
Leave on ice for 15 min for blocking.
Add 200 μL of OWB to each well and an empty well as a reference.
Wait for the organoids to settle to the bottom.
Remove 200 μL from each well using an empty well as a reference to ensure that 200 μL is left in each well.
Add 200 μL of OWB containing a 2× dilution of primary antibodies, resulting in 400 μL of a 1× antibody solution per well.
Incubate for between 16 to 20 hours at 4°C on a horizontal shaker.
Add 1 mL of OWB to each well and wait 2 minutes for the organoids to sink to the bottom.
Remove 1 mL of OWB and replace it with fresh 1 mL of OWB.
Leave on a gentle shaker for 2 hours at 21°C.
Repeat steps 8g and h two more times.
Wait 2 minutes for the organoids to sink to the bottom.
Add 200 μL of OWB containing a 2× dilution of secondary antibodies, resulting in 400 μL of a 1× antibody solution per well.
Incubate for between 16 to 20 hours at 4°C on a horizontal shaker.
Add 1 mL of OWB to each well and wait 2 minutes for the organoids to sink to the bottom.
Remove 1 mL of OWB and replace it with fresh 1 mL of OWB.
Leave on a gentle shaker for 2 hours at 21°C.
Repeat steps 8m and n two more times.
Wait 2 minutes for the organoids to sink to the bottom.
Add 200 μL OWB containing a 2× dilution of DAPI.
Incubate for 10 minutes.
Add 1 mL of OWB to each well.
Wait 2 minutes for the organoids to sink to the bottom.
Remove 1 mL of OWB from each well.
Replace removed OWB with 1 mL of PBS.
Stick a 0.12 mm deep spacer onto a coverslip.
Pipette organoids into the well created by the spacer.
Remove as much leftover fluid as possible.
Add a drop of organoid mounting media to each well containing organoids.
Seal by sticking another coverslip on top.
Store mounted organoids at 4°C in the dark.
Isolate oviduct epithelial cells from Tdtomatoflox/flox mice.
Seed isolated cells in 2D cultures as outlined in steps 1–3.
Culture cells until they reach 40%–50% confluency, usually around 2 days.
Dilute Cre-expressing adenovirus to a final working concentration of 1.2 × 10^6 pfu/mL in pre-warmed 2D media.
Remove media from 2D cultures.
Replace media with 200 μL of 2D media containing the adenovirus.
Culture for between 16 to 20 hours in a humidified 37°C incubator supplied with 5% CO2.
Alternatively, use 50 μL of virus-containing media per well and culture for 4 hours.
Top up to 200 μL before culturing for between 16 to 20 hours.
Dilute Cre-expressing adenovirus to a final working concentration of 1.2 × 10^6 pfu/mL in prewarmed organoid media.
Remove media from organoid cultures.
Replace with organoid media containing the adenovirus.
Culture for between 16 to 20 hours in a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Replace the media with fresh organoid media.
Confirm successful transduction by expression of Tdtomato after 3–5 days.
